added.description:
Company Description

At Henry Ford Health, we're committed to advancing health and improving lives for the millions of people we serve across Michigan and around the world. As one of the nation's leading academic health systems, we provide a comprehensive continuum of care that includes primary and preventive services, specialty and complex care, virtual care, pharmacy, home health, eye care, health insurance, and more. With 12 hospitals and hundreds of ambulatory care locations, including former Ascension Southeast Michigan and Flint Region facilities, our growing network expands access to exceptional care in the communities we serve.

Headquartered in Detroit, Henry Ford Health is helping shape the future of healthcare through the transformative Future of Health: Detroit initiative, a $3 billion investment that is redefining our academic healthcare campus and advancing innovation, research, education, and community impact.

Our work is grounded in purpose, collaboration, and belonging. We empower team members to grow their careers, contribute innovative ideas, and make a meaningful difference every day. Whether you're caring for patients, supporting operations, conducting research, or driving new solutions, you'll be part of a team united by a shared mission: delivering exceptional care, advancing health outcomes, and building healthier communities for all.

Job Description

General Summary:

The Senior (Sr.) Application Analyst is responsible for participating in the overall design, implementation, training, documentation, operation, and support of Clinical or Business applications and reports. This includes contributing to the planning, design, implementation, and optimization of their specific application. The Sr. Application Analyst takes general direction from their supervisor or manager. The Sr. Application Analyst may in some instances also serve as a Helios liaison to their associated clinical or business departments throughout the system. This includes, but is not limited to, the assessment of optimization efforts to meet system goals including patient safety/quality of care, revenue capture and efficient operations. The Sr. Application Analyst performs these activities following Henry Ford Health standards and processes.

Qualifications

Education & Experience Required:

Associates Degree / two (2) years of college required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
Requires more than two years of strong experience in one of the following:
Technical experience:
Strong knowledge of state-of-the art engineering approaches in design, build, testing, debugging problems, and ongoing technical support.
Able to articulate previous examples of workflows and processes associated with previous IT experience.

AND/OR

Clinical experience includes:
Strong knowledge/experience in clinical workflows and processes.
Able to articulate previous examples of workflows and processes associated with clinical experience integrated with IT solutions.

AND/OR

Revenue experience includes:
Specific knowledge of one or more of the following: bed management, registration, scheduling, revenue cycle reports, professional billing, hospital billing, medical records, or coding.
Additionally, must be able to articulate revenue cycle workflows and processes for one or more of the above areas with a focus on IT integrated solutions.

Certifications Required

Epic accreditation or certification in designated application (may hire into position without accreditation or certification but must attain accreditation or certification within first 6 months of hire to continue employment.)

added.title: MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager
added.description:
MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager

Direct Hire

Addison, TX (Hybrid)

We are seeking an experienced Techno-Functional Business Systems Analyst / Project Manager to play a key role in an upcoming Microsoft Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) migration and upgrade initiative.

This individual will serve as a primary liaison between internal business stakeholders, IT teams, developers, and our selected implementation partner. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience supporting or leading Dynamics AX to D365 upgrade/migration projects, with the ability to evaluate, coordinate, and implement moves, adds, changes, enhancements, configurations, and customizations within the ERP environment.
This is a permanent role that will support the organization throughout the implementation lifecycle and transition into an ongoing D365 application support, administration, enhancement, and optimization role following go-live.
We are looking to bring this individual onboard prior to project kickoff so they can gain a strong understanding of our current AX environment, business processes, integrations, data, customizations, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

AX to D365 Migration & Project Delivery: Serve as an internal subject matter resource throughout the Dynamics AX to D365 F&O migration, partnering with the implementation vendor, internal IT, developers, and business stakeholders from discovery through go-live and stabilization.
Application Moves, Adds & Changes: Own and coordinate ongoing moves, adds, changes, enhancements, and modifications across the AX/D365 application environment. Evaluate business requests, determine system impact, document requirements, define acceptance criteria, and oversee changes through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Configuration & Customization: Evaluate whether business requirements can be addressed through standard D365 configuration, workflow changes, extensions, integrations, reporting changes, or custom development. Partner with technical resources on required customizations while helping the organization minimize unnecessary customization of the D365 platform.
Business & Technical Requirements: Lead requirements-gathering sessions to document current-state processes and define future-state requirements. Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and system specifications.
Application Enhancement Management: Manage requests for new functionality and enhancements following established change-management processes. Analyze requested changes for impacts to modules, integrations, data, security roles, workflows, reporting, and other business processes.
Fit-Gap & Customization Analysis: Perform fit-gap analysis between the organization's existing AX functionality and D365 capabilities. Identify which legacy AX customizations should be retained, redesigned, replaced with native D365 functionality, or retired as part of the migration.
Project Management & Vendor Coordination: Help manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, change requests, and deliverables. Act as a knowledgeable internal advocate when working with the D365 implementation partner and challenge proposed solutions when they do not align with business or technical requirements.
Functional Configuration: Participate in the configuration and ongoing support of applicable D365 modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Management.
Technical & Integration Coordination: Work closely with developers, architects, and vendors on interfaces, integrations, APIs, data entities, workflows, reports, batch processes, and custom extensions, ensuring technical solutions align with business requirements.
Data Migration & Mapping: Support source-to-target mapping, legacy AX data analysis, cleansing, transformation, conversion, financial reconciliation, validation, and cutover activities.
Testing & Release Validation: Develop and coordinate test scenarios for SIT, UAT, regression testing, and post-deployment validation. Ensure moves, adds, changes, configurations, and customizations are properly tested before being introduced into production.
Security & Role Changes: Partner with IT and business leadership to manage changes to D365 security roles, duties, privileges, user access, workflows, and segregation-of-duties requirements as the organization evolves.
Cutover & Go-Live: Support release planning, cutover, go-live readiness, deployment validation, issue resolution, and post-production hypercare.
Documentation & Change Management: Maintain documentation for business processes, system configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, application changes, test results, and operating procedures.
Post-Go-Live Application Ownership: Following implementation, serve as a key resource for D365 application support, production issues, moves/adds/changes, configuration changes, enhancements, customizations, upgrades, release management, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
Experience participating in or leading an AX to D365 upgrade, migration, or transformation project.
Demonstrated experience supporting application moves, adds, changes, configurations, enhancements, and customizations within Dynamics AX or D365.
Ability to determine when a business requirement should be solved through configuration versus customization or development.
Experience gathering and translating requirements between business users, developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and implementation partners.
Strong understanding of the ERP lifecycle, including requirements, fit-gap analysis, configuration, customization, development coordination, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and production support.
Experience coordinating SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and production validation.
Experience with ERP data migration, mapping, reconciliation, and legacy-system conversion.
Strong project management skills, including management of scope, timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, change requests, and vendor deliverables.

D365 configuration and application administration
AX-to-D365 upgrade/migration projects
D365 extensions and customizations
Workflows and business processes
Integrations, interfaces, APIs, and data entities
Azure DevOps
Lifecycle Services (LCS)
Power Platform / Power Automate
Power BI and D365 reporting
SQL and data analysis
Security roles, duties, and privileges
SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release management

added.title: SAP Data Integration Engineer
added.description:
oXya is an independent provider of cloud and managed services, specializing in SAP technical services and cloud solutions. We support midsize and global enterprises in increasing the efficiency, stability, and flexibility of their mission-critical IT systems.

Our dedicated teams of experts operate as an extension of our clients’ IT organizations, delivering hands-on technical expertise and long-term partnership. As an independent advisor, we help clients select the most appropriate technical solutions for their business needs — and manage those solutions end-to-end.

oXya runs SAP and related systems across a variety of environments, including private cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-performing operations.

About the Role

As part of our continued growth, we are expanding our capabilities in SAP data modernization and multi-cloud integration. We are looking for an SAP Data Integration Engineer to design, build, and support reliable data integration solutions between SAP systems and modern cloud data platforms.

This role sits at the intersection of SAP technology, enterprise data engineering, and cloud architecture. The successful candidate will help clients unlock SAP data for analytics, BI, AI/ML, reporting, and operational use cases while ensuring secure, scalable, and well-governed data flows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SAP Data Integration

Design, build, and operate data pipelines connecting SAP systems with cloud and enterprise data platforms.
Work with SAP integration and replication technologies such as SAP SLT, SAP Datasphere, SAP CPI / Integration Suite, SAP BTP connectivity services, and related SAP data tools.
Analyze SAP source systems, including ECC, S/4HANA, BW, ODP, CDS views, ABAP tables, and core business data structures.
Implement secure connectivity patterns using tools and approaches such as SAP Cloud Connector, Private Link, VPN, and cloud-native networking.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize end-to-end data flows across SAP, cloud, and BI/analytics layers.

Enterprise Data Engineering

Design, develop, and optimize data models and pipelines on modern cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Amazon Redshift, or equivalent technologies.
Use modern data engineering tools and frameworks such as dbt, Dataform, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Fivetran, Kafka, or similar platforms where appropriate.
Apply best practices for performance, cost optimization, reliability, automation, and maintainability.
Support CI/CD and version control practices for data pipelines and integration artifacts.

PROJECT/CHANGE MANAGEMENT

Architecture, Governance, and Documentation

Contribute to integration architecture across SAP and non-SAP systems, including batch, CDC, streaming, API-based, and event-driven integration patterns.
Define practical ingestion, transformation, and replication strategies aligned with client requirements and operational constraints.
Document technical designs, data flows, lineage, operational procedures, and support handover materials.
Promote sound data governance, data quality, security, and compliance practices when handling client data.

Delivery

Support planning, technical decision-making, risk identification, and delivery execution in project-based and managed services environments.
Take ownership of technical topics from design through support, with attention to supportability and operational readiness.

COMMUNICATION/PRESENCE

Work closely with SAP Basis, functional teams, cloud architects, BI teams, security teams, project managers, and client stakeholders, including distributed teams.
Operate effectively in client-facing environments, translating business requirements into practical technical solutions.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to clients, helping stakeholders understand SAP data structures, integration options, governance considerations, and modernization roadmaps.
Actively contribute to pre-sales, solutioning, and client workshops by helping define integration architectures, estimate delivery effort, identify risks, and present technical recommendations to clients and prospects.
Support workshops, solution reviews, technical handovers, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Mentor and guide team members on SAP data integration, cloud data engineering, and modern integration patterns, strengthening internal expertise and delivery consistency across projects.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

Hands-on experience with at least one SAP data integration or replication technology, such as SAP SLT, SAP Datasphere, SAP CPI / Integration Suite, SAP Data Intelligence, or equivalent SAP integration tooling.
Strong understanding of SAP source systems and data structures, especially ECC and/or S/4HANA.
Strong SQL skills and practical experience with at least one modern cloud data platform, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Amazon Redshift, or equivalent.
Experience designing, building, supporting, or troubleshooting data pipelines in enterprise environments.
Understanding of APIs, REST/SOAP services, event-based integration, message queues, or enterprise integration patterns.
Understanding of governance, security, lineage, and compliance considerations for enterprise data.
Ability to document technical solutions clearly and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills, ownership, and ability to work across multiple clients and priorities.
Curious, adaptable, and willing to learn across SAP, cloud, and data engineering technologies; structured and quality-focused, with strong attention to documentation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

2–3 years of hands-on experience with cloud data engineering or modern data platform delivery.
Experience with orchestration, transformation, or ingestion tools such as Airflow, dbt, Dataform, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Fivetran, Kafka, or similar technologies.
Knowledge of Python for data transformation, automation, scripting, or pipeline support.
Experience with SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Connector, hybrid connectivity, private networking, or cloud security patterns.
Familiarity with ODP, CDS views, ABAP debugging, and SAP functional data areas such as FI/CO, MM, or SD.
Experience in industries such as manufacturing, retail, financial services, or other SAP-intensive sectors.
Awareness of emerging SAP data modernization solutions, including SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere evolution, and the SAP-Databricks partnership, with an interest in helping clients leverage these technologies for advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
SAP certification in SAP Datasphere, SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, or related SAP technology.
Cloud or data platform certification in GCP (Professional Data Engineer), Microsoft Azure (Azure Data Engineer Associate), AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience in SAP, data integration, or cloud data engineering will also be considered.
7+ years of experience in SAP technical, SAP integration, data integration, or enterprise data roles.
Proven experience delivering SAP-to-cloud or SAP-to-enterprise data integration solutions.
Practical experience supporting production-grade data pipelines, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
Experience working in consulting, managed services, or complex multi-client enterprise environments is preferred.

Why Join Us

Work on Mission-Critical SAP Environments:
Gain hands-on experience with complex enterprise systems that support global business operations.
Bridge SAP and Modern Cloud Data Platforms:
Help clients modernize how they access, move, govern, and use SAP data.
Collaborate with Experienced Experts:
Work alongside skilled SAP, cloud, data, and infrastructure professionals who value knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Grow Your Career:
Develop high-demand expertise across SAP integration, data engineering, cloud platforms, and enterprise architecture.
Shape Next-Generation SAP Data Platforms:
Work with emerging technologies such as SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, cloud-native analytics platforms, and AI-ready data architectures.

This is a highly hands-on opportunity for a data engineering professional with 5+ years of experience who has previously helped build or rebuild a production data environment rather than simply maintain an established platform.

The Data Engineer will play a key role in establishing scalable data architecture, governance, modeling, and ETL/ELT practices using Microsoft Fabric, SQL, lakehouse and warehouse technologies, and modern data engineering principles. This role offers the opportunity to help shape the foundation of a growing data function while partnering closely with business and technology stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Design and build scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows that integrate data from databases, APIs, files, enterprise applications, and third-party platforms.
Develop and support Microsoft Fabric solutions, including Data Factory pipelines, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflow Gen2, notebooks, and related data services.
Establish data architecture, modeling, mapping, and governance practices that improve data quality, lineage, security, consistency, and accessibility.
Design and optimize relational, dimensional, lakehouse, and warehouse data structures to support reporting, analytics, and operational requirements.
Implement monitoring, performance optimization, data quality controls, and operational support for business-critical data pipelines and platforms.
Partner with technical and business stakeholders to understand existing data sources, workflows, dependencies, and requirements while helping define the organization's future-state data architecture.

Qualifications

5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, ETL/ELT development, data integration, database development, or a related enterprise data role, including hands-on experience building production-grade data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, along with strong SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT, data architecture, and data governance skills.
Experience helping build, rebuild, or modernize an enterprise data environment, including establishing architecture, standards, governance, and engineering best practices.
Experience with relational databases, lakehouse and warehouse platforms, API integrations, file-based ingestion, orchestration, monitoring, and data quality practices; Python or similar scripting experience is valued.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
Strong communication and stakeholder-facing skills, with the ability to work independently, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and serve as a trusted technical partner. Relevant Microsoft, Azure, Fabric, data, or cloud certifications are preferred.

What Success Looks Like

This position requires more than technical expertise. Our client is looking for someone who is proactive, curious, professional, collaborative, and customer-focused. The successful Data Engineer will communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders, operate effectively without constant oversight, take ownership of problems, and be willing to step in wherever needed to support the broader team.

The IT organization is undergoing change and restructuring with an emphasis on stronger collaboration and breaking down silos. This creates an opportunity for someone who wants to help improve an existing environment, contribute ideas, support teammates, and grow alongside the organization.
